name: Edamame, frozen, unprepared, USDA with disclosed completion

field_method_details.selenium_ug: 0.8 µg from USDA SR 168411, prepared product. Borrowed proxy, not measured for unprepared or retail SKU.
field_method_details.vitamin_a_mcg: 15 µg RAE from USDA SR 168411, prepared product; proxied across preparation state.
field_method_details.sfa: 0.62 g SFA per 100g donor, multiplied by 4.73/5.20 (total fat ratio); imputed.
field_method_details.salt: 6 mg sodium × 2.54/1000, derived from unprepared USDA sodium.
field_method_details.added_sugar: Assumed 0 for plain unsweetened frozen edamame; not declared in USDA SR record.
field_method_details.vitamin_b12_mcg: Assumed 0 for plain unfortified soybeans; not confirmed by primary USDA record.
field_method_details.vitamin_d_mcg: Assumed 0 for plain unfortified soybeans; not confirmed by primary USDA record.

model_assumptions.fatty_acid_scaling: The prepared and unprepared USDA records are different states of the same food. Relative fatty acid fractions are provisionally assumed comparable.
model_assumptions.market_label_mismatch: Retail 128.7 kcal, P12/F4.3/C10.5 versus reference 109 kcal, P11.2/F4.73/C7.61. This is NOT an exact formulation-level match.
model_assumptions.hei: No HEI/FPED equivalence included: require independent review before analytical use.
model_assumptions.zero_policy: Assumed zeros are explicitly marked and must not be described as measured absence.
model_assumptions.crosscheck_warning: A third-party page titled 'Edamame, frozen, unprepared' reports different macronutrients (10.25g protein, 8.58g carbohydrate); its record mapping is not verified. The FDC 168410 profile here is corroborated by sources that agree on 11.2g protein, 7.61g carbohydrate and 109kcal.
